records.text: Owens said Charlie Kirk wore a customized Carhartt Freedom shirt on September 10 rather than the standard shirt later sold to supporters and said she believed the custom shirt was either 50% or 95% polyester.

verification.notes: Transcript context and published images support that Kirk wore a white Freedom shirt and that a later official version was sold. Live searches found no reliable manufacturer record, invoice, garment provenance, or independent confirmation establishing that the September 10 garment was a customized Carhartt item rather than merely bearing an apparent Carhartt label.
